title: Fast join → deposit → first game

questions.title: Can welcome free spins unlock when the deposit is detected, not confirmed?
questions.text: Can welcome free spins unlock when the deposit is detected, not confirmed?
questions.context: Needle is <2 min to first casino bet (BRIEF.md), but BTC takes ~6 min to arrive on BOL (Journey_Audits_2026 p.3). Today Use Free Spins only appears at 2/2 confirmations (cashier-sheet.tsx DepositConfirmedActions), so the player waits minutes with nothing to play.
questions.why: Decides whether the tracker screen gets a Play button the moment we see the transfer, or stays a wait screen until confirmed.

options.label: Unlock on detected (recommended)
options.detail: Spins go live when the transfer is seen on-chain; tracker shows Use Free Spins while confirmations finish.

options.label: Unlock on confirmed (today)
options.detail: Keep the wait; we only add a balance toast with Play for players who closed the wallet.

options.label: Unlock at sign-up
options.detail: A few no-deposit spins right after Welcome, the rest on deposit; needs a new offer from product.

questions.title: Should the OTP stay a gate before the account exists?
questions.text: Should the OTP stay a gate before the account exists?
questions.context: BRD lists OTP as a must-have. Shipped Verify (auth-modal.tsx JoinVerifyPanel, AUTH_JOIN.md journey 5) blocks account creation until the code is entered, which adds a full step before deposit. Audit p.2: Whale auto-validates, Winna/Rainbet/Stake verify email but with 2–3 fields on screen one.
questions.why: Gate keeps two screens before Welcome; deferring makes join one screen and moves Name + OTP to before the first withdrawal.

options.label: Keep Verify before account (recommended)
options.detail: Email, Password, 18+ → Name + OTP → Welcome; we cut taps elsewhere (preselected BTC, one-tap play).

options.label: Verify after first game
options.detail: Account created on step one; Name + OTP asked as a compact card before first withdrawal.

options.label: Verify while deposit confirms
options.detail: Name + OTP shown inside the deposit tracker so the wait time does the work.

images.caption: Join screen art (Verify uses the same panel)

questions.title: Welcome spins: 10 a day for 10 days, or 100 at once?
questions.text: Welcome spins: 10 a day for 10 days, or 100 at once?
questions.context: Join art says "claim 10 free spins a day for 10 days" (public/shell/auth/welcome-offer-crypto.jpg), but the code grants 100 spins on Chicken right after the deposit (lib/lumen/vip-hub.ts WELCOME_FREE_SPINS spinsTotal 100). The first-game screen copy depends on it.
questions.why: Changes the post-deposit card ("100 Free Spins" vs "10 spins today · 9 days left") and whether we add a daily return reminder.

options.label: 10 a day for 10 days (recommended)
options.detail: Match the art; first session shows 10 spins and a day counter that brings them back (week-one retention).

options.label: 100 at once
options.detail: Match the code; fix the art copy instead.

images.caption: Offer art: 10 a day for 10 days
